So our next step is for everyone to declare what position they'd like to run for.

A general outline for duties would be (This is from the constitution template + chatgpt, so some things might not apply):

The President:

    -Coordinates all activities of the organization
    -Calls regular and special meetings
    -Prepares agendas for meetings
    -Presides over all meetings
    -Represents the organization in official functions
    -Ensures that all members fulfill their responsibilities
    -Acts as the primary liaison between the organization and school administration
    -Oversees committees and assigns tasks as needed
    -Ensures that the organization adheres to its constitution and bylaws
    -Guides and supports executive board members

The Vice President:

    -Assists the President in all duties and responsibilities
    -Presides over meetings in the absence of the President
    -Serves as a liaison between committees and the executive board
    -Helps coordinate events and initiatives
    -Ensures smooth communication among members and officers
    -Takes on special projects as needed
    -Assumes the role of President if the President is unable to fulfill duties

The Treasurer:

    -Manages the financial affairs of the organization
    -Prepares and maintains financial records and budgets
    -Collects and deposits membership dues and other funds
    -Approves and tracks all expenditures
    -Prepares financial reports for meetings and administration
    -Ensures compliance with school financial policies
    -Assists in fundraising efforts and financial planning
    -Works with the executive board to allocate funds effectively

There are three core roles we have to fill:
President
Vice President
Treasures (i mispoke when i said secretary)
